language.name: Filipino
language.canonical_note: Canonical Filipino course; do not duplicate it as a country-specific Tagalog entity.

needs: ng as a unit in native vocabulary
orthography_pronunciation.voice_strategy: Synthetic Filipino browser voice when available; fallback must be disclosed, never described as native recording.

grammar: predicate-initial clauses and marked topic alternatives
actor and undergoer voice with um/mag/in/i and related affixes
completed, progressive, contemplated and infinitive aspect
register_pragmatics: stance particles nga, pala, yata, naman
Taglish and regional variation treated descriptively rather than as deficiency

CEFR_progression.A1: sound-spelling, introductions, ang phrases, basic predicates, po/ba
CEFR_progression.A2: aspect in routines/events, quantity, directions, requests
CEFR_progression.B1: voice choice, relative clauses, narration, reported information
CEFR_progression.B2: complex aspect/voice, stance particles, formal-informal transformation
CEFR_progression.C1: academic synthesis, official communication, controlled voice and register
CEFR_progression.C2: scope, implication, rhetoric, idiom, genre transformation and cultural pragmatics
